publishedfiledetails.title: VFX+
publishedfiledetails.description:
VFX+ is a mod that aims to remake much of Terraria’s visual effects from the ground up without impacting functionality.

The mod currently reworks the VFX (and often SFX too) of nearly every single Mage weapon, with other classes and changes coming in the future.

Every individual weapon change can be turned on or off via the config.

VFX+ should be compatible with most mods (Yes, including Calamity), just don’t expect it to play nice with anything that heavily reworks vanilla weapons.

Multiplayer is untested at this point but should be mostly fine, although ALL players will need the mod enabled. 
[quote=tModLoader VFXPlus]
Developed By Linty[/quote]

publishedfiledetails.title: VFX+ Boss Addon
publishedfiledetails.description:
VFX+ Boss Addon is an addon for GreatFriend129's VFXPlus. This mod overhauls boss visuals without impacting functionality.

This mod is in Alpha, and as such is still a work in progress. More content will be added in the future, and some of the existing content may be changed or removed.

[hr][/hr]

The mod [i] completely reworks [/i] the VFX and SFX of the Lunatic Cultist and the Wall Of Flesh. I'm aiming to add more bosses in the future, but for now these are the only two.

Each individual boss overhaul can be turned on or off via the config.

Like the original, this mod should be compatible with most other mods including Calamity, [u] However, some mods may use their own projectiles mimicking vanilla ones, which [b] will not be changed. [/b] [/u]

Multiplayer is untested but should be alright, although ALL players will need the mod enabled. 

[hr][/hr]

VFX+ Boss Addon is released under the GNU General Public License v3.0.
You should have received a copy of the license along with this code.

[b] DISCLAIMER: While all efforts have been made to keep the changes purely visual, some attacks may have slight differences in angles or damage. [/b][quote=tModLoader VFXPlusBoss]
Developed By Bluebasher5[/quote]

publishedfiledetails.title: Vanilla Slash VFX
publishedfiledetails.description:
[h1][b]Vanilla Slash VFX[/b][/h1]

[h2]This mod adds vanilla [b]Excalibur[/b]-like slash effects to most sword-type weapons(usestyle = swing), including [b]modded weapons[/b].[/h2]

The effect's color is sampled from the [b]weapon's texture[/b].

It's purely a texture-based effect with [b]no[/b] additional shader overhead.

publishedfiledetails.title: Crit VFX
publishedfiledetails.description:
Crit VFX is a lightweight, client-side visual enhancement mod that makes critical hits feel powerful and satisfying without affecting gameplay balance.

This mod focuses entirely on presentation, adding impactful particles, screen shake, and custom audio feedback whenever a critical hit occurs.

FEATURES
• Custom crit particle effects with multiple visual styles
• Adjustable particle size and intensity
• Screen shake on crits (configurable strength)
• Custom crit sound effects
• Multiple sound slots with optional random selection
• Adjustable crit sound volume
• Optional enhanced crit combat text
• Fully client-side (safe for multiplayer)
• Compatible with Terraria 1.4.4+ and modpacks

All features can be configured in the Mod Configuration menu and changed at any time.

Crit VFX is designed to work alongside balance mods, weapon mods, and overhauls without conflict.[quote=tModLoader CritVFX]
Developed By 2xClean[/quote]

publishedfiledetails.title: Hellkite SFX + VFX (Llow - The End)
publishedfiledetails.description:
[img]https://images.steamusercontent.com/ugc/15585824561185954338/CD7E161BBE31FBF9145A04997D441B5061C7686C/?imw=5000&imh=5000&ima=fit&impolicy=Letterbox&imcolor=%23000000&letterbox=false[/img]

[i]An expansion mod for the Hellkite sword from Calamity Mod.[/i]
[i]Adds a deep charge mechanic, Divine Fury system, and reactive audio-visual effects.[/i]

[hr][/hr]

[h2]⚔ Charge System[/h2]

Hold [b]Right Click[/b] to charge the blade. The longer you hold, the more powerful the strike — scaling from base damage up to a full critical hit at maximum charge.

[list]
[*]Releasing early still grants a partial damage bonus
[*]Charge power is reflected in damage scaling and lightning intensity
[*]Background music gradually fades during charge, putting full focus on the strike
[*]Missing a swing or releasing too early [b]resets[/b] the Divine Fury counter
[/list]

[hr][/hr]

[h2]Divine Fury[/h2]

Landing [b]fully charged strikes[/b] builds the Divine Fury counter.

[b]Fury Mode:[/b]
[list]
[*]Blade is permanently fully charged
[*]Every strike always critically hits and deals maximum damage
[*]Enhanced lightning effects trigger on every hit
[/list]

[b]Counter resets on:[/b]
[list]
[*]Swinging with LMB
[*]Releasing RMB before full charge
[*]Missing a fully charged swing
[/list]

[hr][/hr]

[h2]Lightning Modes[/h2]

Every charged strike releases scorching lightning. Three modes are available — choose your preferred style in the mod config.

[h3]Fan — bolts spread toward the cursor[/h3]
[img]https://media0.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExeHcyaXFrbzlxc3l1bjd3bjNhYWlqY2Q4d3Q0OWcyc2FyM3ZzYTRhMyZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/IZtisoctTmFcY6u0pl/giphy.gif[/img]

[h3]All Sides — bolts converge from all directions[/h3]
[img]https://media0.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExZGs2Y3BsNTJiN2VheGVkZmV5ZTh4aW1neXJmbjd3MXd4MHVsenkzeCZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/OMn16ueTaXLmvWtlVz/giphy.gif[/img]

[h3]From Above — bolts fall from the sky[/h3]
[img]https://media2.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExb2ZnZmNsNHpyNmtxZ3VyOHFqb25obDJxZmFrcXNhZGl4d3JidmdrMiZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/Fd9k7UKOUOf9Qb6haW/giphy.gif[/img]

Lightning also deals damage over time to enemies near the bolts — [i]10% of the strike damage per second[/i].

[hr][/hr]

[h2]⚙ Config Options[/h2]

[list]
[*][b]Hit Sound Volume[/b] — adjust the volume of impact sounds
[*][b]Lightning Visual Mode[/b] — Fan / All Sides / From Above
[*][b]Visual Only Mode[/b] — disables all damage scaling and lightning damage, keeping effects purely cosmetic
[/list]

[hr][/hr]

[h2]Requirements[/h2]

[list]
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2824688266]Calamity Mod[/url] — required
[/list]

[hr][/hr]

[h2]Localization[/h2]

[list]
[*][b]English[/b] ✓
[*][b]Русский[/b] ✓
[/list]

[hr][/hr]

[h2]Roadmap[/h2]

This mod is actively in development. Planned features and improvements are on the way — stay tuned for updates.

[hr][/hr]

[h2]Credits[/h2]

[list]
[*]Sound samples sourced from: [url=https://youtu.be/LusgCAwXCVw]https://youtu.be/LusgCAwXCVw[/url]
[*]Built on top of [b]Calamity Mod[/b] by MountainDrew/Fabsol
  [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2824688266]Steam Workshop[/url] — [url=https://github.com/CalamityTeam/CalamityModPublic]GitHub[/url]
[/list]

[quote=Hellkite: The End]'Feel the strength of a blade forged through passion'[/quote]

[hr][/hr]

[h2]Русская версия описания[/h2]

[hr][/hr]

[img]https://images.steamusercontent.com/ugc/15585824561185954338/CD7E161BBE31FBF9145A04997D441B5061C7686C/?imw=5000&imh=5000&ima=fit&impolicy=Letterbox&imcolor=%23000000&letterbox=false[/img]

[i]Мод-расширение для меча Hellkite из Calamity Mod.[/i]
[i]Добавляет механику зарядки, систему Божественной Ярости и реактивные аудиовизуальные эффекты.[/i]

[hr][/hr]

[h2]⚔ Система зарядки[/h2]

Зажмите [b]ПКМ[/b] для зарядки клинка. Чем дольше удерживаете — тем мощнее удар: от базового урона до полного крита при максимальном заряде.

[list]
[*]Ранний выпад всё равно даёт частичный бонус к урону
[*]Сила заряда отражается в скалировании урона и интенсивности молний
[*]Фоновая музыка постепенно затихает во время зарядки
[*]Промах или преждевременный выпад [b]сбрасывают[/b] счётчик Ярости
[/list]

[hr][/hr]

[h2]Божественная Ярость[/h2]

Попадания [b]полностью заряженными ударами[/b] накапливают счётчик Божественной Ярости.

[b]Режим Ярости:[/b]
[list]
[*]Клинок постоянно полностью заряжен
[*]Каждый удар всегда критует и наносит максимальный урон
[*]Усиленные молнии при каждом попадании
[/list]

[b]Счётчик сбрасывается при:[/b]
[list]
[*]Ударе ЛКМ
[*]Отпускании ПКМ до полного заряда
[*]Промахе полностью заряженным ударом
[/list]

[hr][/hr]

[h2]Виды молний[/h2]

Каждый заряженный удар выпускает обжигающие молнии. Доступны три режима — выберите предпочитаемый в конфиге мода.

[i]Смотрите гифки выше[/i]

Молнии также наносят урон со временем врагам рядом с болтами — [i]10% от урона удара в секунду[/i].

[hr][/hr]

[h2]⚙ Настройки[/h2]

[list]
[*][b]Громкость звуков ударов[/b] — регулировка громкости звуков попадания
[*][b]Режим отображения молний[/b] — Веер / Со всех сторон / С неба
[*][b]Только визуальные эффекты[/b] — отключает всё скалирование урона и урон от молний, оставляя эффекты чисто косметическими
[/list]

[hr][/hr]

[h2]Зависимости[/h2]

[list]
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2824688266]Calamity Mod[/url] — обязателен
[/list]

[hr][/hr]

[h2]Локализация[/h2]

[list]
[*][b]English[/b] ✓
[*][b]Русский[/b] ✓
[/list]

[hr][/hr]

[h2]Планы развития[/h2]

Мод активно разрабатывается. Новые функции и улучшения уже в планах — следите за обновлениями.

[hr][/hr]

[h2]Авторство[/h2]

[list]
[*]Семплы звуков взяты отсюда: [url=https://youtu.be/LusgCAwXCVw]https://youtu.be/LusgCAwXCVw[/url]
[*]Мод основан на [b]Calamity Mod[/b] от MountainDrew/Fabsol
  [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2824688266]Steam Workshop[/url] — [url=https://github.com/CalamityTeam/CalamityModPublic]GitHub[/url]
[/list]

[quote=Hellkite: The End]'Почувствуй силу клинка, выкованного через страсть'[/quote][quote=tModLoader HellkiteTheEnd]
Developed By sltx[/quote]

publishedfiledetails.title: Every weapon deserves to feel distinct
publishedfiledetails.description:
This mod is a complete overhaul of Terraria’s spear playstyle.

As its initial release, the mod reworks every existing spear in the game. Going forward, I plan to update it as often as possible—ideally every day—and gradually rework other weapons that I personally love but rarely get a real chance to use in actual gameplay.

Here are a few examples of what has been implemented so far:

① VFX have been added to spear-type weapons, greatly improving their visual feedback and overall feel when used.

② Spear-type weapons now have a 1-in-3 chance to perform two consecutive thrusts.
Some spears even have special mechanics that are triggered by this extra attack. 😎

There are also differences between individual weapons. For example, the Trident has a 1-in-5 chance to perform three consecutive thrusts instead.

③ The Spear is now craftable.
Several new spear-related accessories have also been added.

④ Hardmode ore spears now have their own unique abilities.
Weapons such as the Cobalt Naginata and Mythril Halberd, which normally see very little use, have received much more distinctive reworks while still keeping the overall feel and atmosphere of vanilla Terraria.

---completion---
To avoid conflicts with other mods in the future, I also plan to make each rework individually toggleable through the mod's configuration settings.
------

For now, the project is being released primarily as a spear rework mod, but the long-term plan is to gradually expand it into a mod that reworks weapons across the entire game.

Please share your own Terraria weapon rework ideas in the comments!

I strongly believe this mod will become much better by rebuilding weapons around the different playstyles, perspectives, and ideas of the Terraria community.[quote=tModLoader Everyweapondeservestofeeldistinct]
Developed By ojo[/quote]

publishedfiledetails.title: Game Feel: Combat Feedback
publishedfiledetails.description:
[h1]游戏手感：打击感反馈 / Game Feel: Combat Feedback[/h1]

为战斗注入街机级打击感的纯客户端手感模组。/ A pure client-side mod that injects arcade-style combat feedback into Terraria.

[h2]特性 / Features[/h2]

[list]
[*][b]命中顿帧 Hit-Stop[/b] — 按轻/中/重/暴击分级冻结目标动作，Boss 独立时长上限 / Tiered frame freeze on hit, separate cap for bosses
[*][b]方向性震屏 Directional Screenshake[/b] — Trauma 模型，随距离衰减，每连击 +10%，偏向击退方向 / Trauma-based shake with distance falloff, +10% per combo, biased toward knockback
[*][b]受击闪白 Hit Flash[/b] — 贝塞尔曲线平滑淡出，可选元素反应配色 / Smooth bezier fade with optional elemental reaction colors
[*][b]暴击圆形光晕 Crit Glow[/b] — 全屏径向光晕，S 形淡入淡出（先慢后快再慢），峰值位置与整体透明度可调，默认关闭 / Full-screen radial glow with a slow-fast-slow S-curve envelope; peak position and overall opacity tunable, off by default
[*][b]命中粒子与弹片 Particles & Shrapnel[/b] — 曲线减速火花、带重力抛物线的机械碎片 / Curve-eased sparks and ballistic debris
[*][b]命中动态光效 Dynamic Hit Lighting[/b] — 真实作用于游戏光照系统 / Feeds the actual game lighting system
[*][b]连击系统 Combo System[/b] — 连击 HUD 显示连击数与累计伤害；[b]超过 50 连击进入狂热态[/b]：连击数彩色渐变 + 彩虹重影拖尾，粒子数量提升 50%；[b]达到 100 连击触发狂热爆发[/b]：大量彩虹粒子迸发、炫彩拖尾与爆发音效 / Combo HUD with total damage; [b]beyond 50 combo, fever mode kicks in[/b]: the counter turns rainbow with a ghost trail and particles ramp up by 50%; [b]at 100 combo a fever burst fires[/b] — a rainbow particle explosion, colorful trail and a burst sound
[*][b]受击镜头冲击 Hurt Camera Kick[/b] — 受伤瞬间镜头向受伤方向后坐 / Camera recoil toward the hurt direction
[*][b]武器挥动残影 Weapon Afterimages[/b] — 挥砍拖尾 / Swing trails
[*][b]分层命中音效 Layered Hit Sounds[/b] — 钝响/骨感/金属脆响随档位变化，暴击提音，逐目标冷却 + 每帧上限防音爆 / Thud/snap/metallic crack by tier with pitched crit accent, per-target cooldown and per-frame cap
[*][b]击杀冲击波 Kill Shockwave[/b] — 击杀扩散光环与径向粒子，Boss 翻倍并伴随爆响 / Expanding ring and radial particles on kill, doubled scale and boom on bosses
[*][b]命中标记 Hit Markers[/b] — 白色十字、暴击金色叉，旋转淡出 / White cross markers, golden spinning X on crits
[*][b]战斗评级 Style Rank[/b] — D→SSS 实时评价驱动反馈强度，SSS 金色暗角与音效，受伤掉级 / Live D→SSS rank boosts feedback; SSS golden vignette and sound, taking damage drops the rank
[*][b]玩家反馈 Player Feedback[/b] — 受击染闪、濒死心跳暗角、受伤方向弧、落地/冲刺尘土、挥砍弧光 / Hurt white flash, low-health heartbeat vignette, damage-direction arc, landing/dash dust, slash arcs
[*][b]类型倍率与黑名单 Class Muls & Blacklist[/b] — 近战/远程/魔法/召唤/其他独立倍率，可按 NPC 屏蔽反馈 / Separate melee/ranged/magic/summon/other multipliers and per-NPC suppression
[*][b]预览与分享 Preview & Share[/b] — 按 P 原地预览全部效果，/gffeed export/import 分享配置码，Boss 击杀/狂热/SSS 自动截图 / Press P to preview all effects, /gffeed export/import share codes, auto screenshots on highlights
[/list]

[h2]配置 / Configuration[/h2]

[list]
[*]克制 / 标准 / 强烈 三档预设一键切换，全部参数可自由微调 / Three presets (Subtle / Standard / Intense), every parameter tunable
[*]内置贝塞尔曲线编辑器（按 [b]G[/b]），自定义每条动画曲线 / Built-in bezier curve editor (press [b]G[/b]) for every animation curve
[*]狂热爆发可配置：开关、爆发粒子量、拖尾时长 / Fever burst is configurable: toggle, particle count, trail duration
[*]支持 ElementalReactions 元素配色（弱依赖，未安装不影响使用） / Optional ElementalReactions color integration (weak reference, works fine without it)
[/list]

[h2]更新公告 / Changelog[/h2]

[b]v1.0.0 — 首次正式发布 / First Stable Release[/b]
[list]
[*]完整的街机级战斗手感反馈管线：命中顿帧、方向性震屏、受击闪白、暴击圆形光晕、命中粒子与弹片、动态光效、击杀冲击波、命中标记 / Full arcade-style combat feedback pipeline: hit-stop, directional shake, hit flash, crit glow, particles & shrapnel, impact light, kill shockwave, hit markers
[*]连击系统（50 连击狂热态 / 100 连击狂热爆发）、D→SSS 战斗评级、分层命中音效 / Combo system (fever at 50, burst at 100), D→SSS style rank, layered hit sounds
[*]镜头反馈：受伤镜头冲击、重击镜头抽近、武器残影、挥砍弧光 / Camera feedback: hurt kick, zoom punch, weapon afterimages, slash arcs
[*]玩家反馈：受击染闪、濒死心跳暗角、受伤方向弧、落地/冲刺尘土、坠落反馈 / Player feedback: hurt flash, low-health heartbeat vignette, damage direction arc, landing & dash dust, fall feedback
[*]战斗机制重写（可选）：四档伤害概率与系数、评级升档、斩杀系统 / Optional combat rewrite: four-tier damage weights & multipliers, rank promotion, execution system
[*]枪械反馈：枪口烟雾/枪口焰/后坐力，子弹命中火花（按材质） / Gun feedback: muzzle smoke & flash & recoil, material-based bullet sparks
[*]实验性镜头系统：移动检测、自由落体、重生、Boss 取景与锁定 / Experimental camera system: motion detection, free fall, respawn, boss framing & lock
[*]内置贝塞尔曲线编辑器、配置分享码、高光时刻自动截图 / Built-in bezier curve editor, config share codes, highlight auto screenshots
[*]全链路对象池化 + 合批渲染，高连击战斗流畅 / Fully pooled with batched rendering for smooth high-combo fights
[/list]

[h2]说明 / Notes[/h2]

纯客户端模组：不添加任何内容物品，单人联机均可使用，服务器与其他玩家无需安装。所有效果默认均衡，晕 3D 或偏好原版手感的玩家可切换"克制"预设或逐项关闭。

Pure client-side: adds no content items, works in single player and multiplayer — the server and other players do not need it installed. Defaults are balanced; switch to the Subtle preset or toggle effects off individually if you prefer a vanilla feel.
[quote=tModLoader GameFeel]
Developed By CEAT[/quote]

publishedfiledetails.title: WeaponOut Lite: An Item Holding Mod
publishedfiledetails.description:
[quote=Flashkirby (for multiplayer)]This is a "NoSync" mod, if you want players to see held items then both they and the server must have the mod installed (otherwise it will be clientside only)[/quote]

[h1]Summary[/h1]
[list]
[*] Displays items you are holding
[*] Customise poses available via the Mod Configuration menu
[/list]

[h1]Details[/h1]
WeaponOut Lite is based on the original feature in WeaponOut before it become a content mod, focussing entirely on displaying held items. This version is just for the vanity effects.

[h1]Credits[/h1]
Developer: Flashkirby
Beta Testers: Karob, RunicPixels, W1K
